description: A mounted officer in a dark cocked hat raises a sword on a rearing bay horse at the center of a stone arch bridge over a rushing stream. Dark-blue-coated infantry with red facings fire and advance from the left, while white-uniformed troops with red-and-white belts fight, stumble and fall on the right, with smoke and musket flashes through the mountain valley. A small tricolour flag is visible on the left, and a fallen soldier lies on the bridge with no visible blood. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.
